index.copy:
Kaiwhakamāori Taitara Matua Aunoa AI Koreutu

He taputapu whakamāori taitara matua ipurangi koreutu e whakakahangia ana e ngā tauira reo nui. Tukuake i ngā kōnae SRT, VTT rānei ASS me te whakamāori taitara matua i waenga i te reo Pākehā, Hainamana, Hapanihi, Kōhia, Pāniora, Wīwī me ētahi atu reo 15+. Kāore he rārangi ingoa, kāore he tāutanga, kāore he waitohu wai — whakatuwheratia ki te pūtirotiro ka tīmata ki te whakamāori. Ka noho tonu ngā raraunga taitara matua ki tō pūtirotiro mā te kore koe e whakaae ki te whakamāori kapua.

Ngā āhuatanga matua: te tātari SRT, VTT me ASS me te whakamāori AI, te whakakotahi rerenga kōrero atamai (ka whakakotahihia ngā tohu, ka whakamāorihia, kātahi ka wawaehia anō ki te rārangi wā taketake), te whakahāngai rārangi wā, te takai rārangi aunoa mō te kuputuhi CJK me te Tai Hauāuru, te tango kupu kī, te whakahaere kupu ritenga, me ngā kāhua whakamāori ka taea te kōwhiri. Kaweake i ngā kōnae SRT, VTT, ASS rānei TXT kua rite ki te tuhi mārō ki runga i tō ataata.

Ko wai e whakamahi ana: ngā kaiwhakamāori ataata, ngā kaihanga YouTube me ngā kaiwhakamāori rohe, ngā ākonga reo, ngā rōpū taitara matua me ngā tīma e hiahia ana ki te whakarōpū wawe i ngā ihirangi ataata.
